projectiles.prompt: Original RTS weapon sprite atlas, transparent PNG, EXACT 8 equal columns and 8 equal rows, isolated fully padded cells, no text, no unit bodies, no borders. Eight animation frames left to right per row. Canonical projectile travels towards RIGHT (east) in screen plane; no camera or ground backdrop. First two frames ignition/muzzle, middle four flying projectile with short tail, final two distinctive small hit and fade. Row1 brass bullet orange muzzle white-hot tiny tracer sparks; row2 dark steel cannon shell broad amber muzzle and dusty explosive impact; row3 physical gray rocket with yellow stripe and red nose, exhaust then orange blast; row4 organic orange citrus acid droplet with green strands and teal glints, wet splash; row5 brown-green seed pod trailing orange pollen, seed burst; row6 slender green thorn with orange core and cyan glint, needle impact; row7 ivory/crimson plasma orb with blue-white hot center, circular energy impact; row8 ivory and red magical bolt with gold edge, star shaped impact. Crisp high detail painted RTS art, shape differences clearly readable at 20-40px. Every cell has 15% padding and fixed center, no overlaps. No borrowed game images, no logos.

impacts.prompt: Original RTS attack sprite atlas, transparent PNG, EXACT 8 equal columns by 8 equal rows, isolated fully padded cells, no text, no unit bodies, no borders. Row6 living vine weapon: green curling thorn vine with orange sap and cyan glints, sweeps towards RIGHT then retracts. Row7 sustained beam endpoints: concentric ivory-red focus rings and escalating cyan-white sparks, no opaque background. Crisp high detail painted RTS art, distinct silhouettes, fixed center and 15% padding each cell, no overlap. No borrowed game images or logos.
